title: Spikers' Turf: Undermanned FEU still too much for VNS
summary: Despite missing key players, Far Eastern University-DN Steel still proved too much for VNS-Laticrete in the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
